newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KUNENE BUYS FURTHER STAKE IN SOUTH AFRICAN COKE BOTTLER.
newsitem.headline: KUNENE BUYS FURTHER STAKE IN SOUTH AFRICAN COKE BOTTLER.

text.p: Black investment group Kunene Brothers Holdings said on Thursday it has acquired Coca-Cola's 13 percent stake in South African Coke bottler Vinto Minerals.
The move brings Kunene's share of Vinto to 64 percent and the firm said it makes them the single largest individual black investor in the South African soft drinks industry.
Vinto is to be renamed Coca-Cola Bottlers of Mpumalanga (CCBM). Kunene is also to pump 20 million rand of new cash into the operation, based in South Africa's eastern province of Mpumalanga.
The first ten million rand will be in the form of an expansion capital investment over the next year and the second ten million rand a marketing investment over the next five years.
Vinto was first formed as a joint-venture between Kunene and Coke in 1994.
